decisive_spans.text: an inflamed, infiltrating, necrotic lesion over the implant site
A swab of the lesion grew Staphylococcus epidermidis

response.rationale: The vignette describes an inflamed, infiltrating, necrotic lesion over the implant site and a swab of the lesion grew Staphylococcus epidermidis, directly supporting a device-related infection. The other candidates are either too specific (e.g., Pacemaker pocket infection, Staphylococcal biofilm infection) or too general (e.g., Staphylococcal infection, Surgical site infection) or contradicted by negative blood cultures (e.g., Staphylococcal epidermidis bacteremia).
